stages.name: facts
stages.description: Deterministic extraction over one snapshot

stages.name: features
stages.description: Group entry points and data accesses into what the program does for a user

stages.name: lock
stages.description: A spec per feature, in its own tool, describing what the system does today
stages.absent_when: the program has no feature to lock

stages.name: intake
stages.description: What the owner must protect: answers, or declared defaults, and the quality scenarios

stages.name: engines
stages.description: Pinned external analyzers, normalised into one fact set
stages.absent_when: no external engine is installed, or --engines was not asked for

stages.name: verify
stages.description: Run the test suite in an isolated copy and map real coverage
stages.absent_when: no test command was given, or execution was not authorised

stages.name: measure
stages.description: One row per analysed file: size, complexity, duplication, change and dependency, each with its source

stages.name: policy
stages.description: Enforce the declared architecture policy

stages.name: load
stages.description: A cost record per entry point, with a stated projection at 1000x

stages.name: claims
stages.description: Facts interpreted into a ledger of falsifiable claims

stages.name: probe
stages.description: Settle every claim whose truth can be decided mechanically

stages.name: semantic
stages.description: Model interpretation over the facts; every output stays a hypothesis

stages.name: sustainability
stages.description: The six sustainability indicators, measured or declared unmeasured

stages.name: transform
stages.description: Canonical homes for repeated definitions, and the move that gets there

stages.name: plan
stages.description: Confirmed claims become task cards ordered into waves

stages.name: target
stages.description: Source inventory and explicitly reviewed target decisions; unknowns remain gaps

stages.name: reports
stages.description: The four reports a client reads first; every other document is an appendix to them

stages.name: quality
stages.description: The four reports judged by Vale (the EAOS style) and markdownlint-cli2 (their structure)
stages.absent_when: neither Vale nor markdownlint-cli2 is installed

stages.name: pdf
stages.description: The one-page executive summary, typeset by Typst from the report's own records
stages.absent_when: Typst, or a font for the report language, is not installed

stages.name: execution_guide
stages.description: Literal, ordered execution instructions for every task card

stages.name: executive
stages.description: Executive view of the measured indicators and their limits

stages.name: compose
stages.description: Human artifacts, each inside its declared line budget

stages.name: bundles
stages.description: Package the same report, preserving the engagement contract

stages.name: emit
stages.description: Files in other tools' own formats, each judged by its own tool

stages.name: site
stages.description: One browsable page over the same records; adds navigation, never content

stages.name: validate
stages.description: Write what the run did and did not do, then judge the output contract
